**Checkpoint A** closes the ecology block (Weeks 2–4). Graded practical + short presentation.

Use Isle Royale (or another series in `data/`) as a qualitative anchor.

## Submit (practical)

1. Your model in words (variables, gains, losses, interactions, question).
2. Implemented simulator + one key plot.
3. Two parameter experiments.
4. Short reflection: which data features you capture vs miss; strongest assumption.

## Presentation (in class, ~3–5 min)

1. Biological question  
2. What you computed  
3. One figure  
4. Strongest assumption / next step  

Pairs/groups OK. Clarity + biological sense + honest limits matter more than polish.

## AI disclosure (required)

Follow the course [AI policy](../../docs/ai-policy.qmd). End the practical write-up with tool + use, or `AI disclosure: none`. You must still be able to explain every figure live.
